S.FORM: alang Atomo ga niya mki sku Hualien Keng atu Kongbu go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 81 buwan, 209 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 76% kyan ku 159 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 24% kyan ku 50 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Amis 74%, binah lihuyan s'uli 1%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Atomo hya' ga bsilung. tay 'zil na Atomo hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na Atomo hya' ga rgyax. tay mkraya' na Atomo hya' ga rgyax. tay 'zil na Atomo hya' ga Tafalong. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ atomo ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku ħualien keŋ atu koŋβu ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ami[s|ɕ] ** βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na atomo ħjaʔ ɣa β[s|ɕ]iluŋ taj ʔzil na atomo ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na atomo ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax taj mkrajaʔ na atomo ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax taj ʔzil na atomo ħjaʔ ɣa ta*aloŋ reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
